adaptations: Same 2x128 MLP, Adam, eight epochs / minimum 2000 steps per task as the registered neural comparison.
A single class-balanced multiclass CE on concatenated stream and author-weighted replay; native binary BCE is not used.
Each current-task presentation is a stream encounter including epoch repeats; counts advance for the whole batch before memory replacement. Replay is not re-counted or re-admitted.
Budget grows to 200 times seen classes including Normal; old discarded examples are never replenished.
Author UNSW minority_allocation=.1 is retained; native mem6666/replay5000/five-epoch binary training is not reproduced.
Author underfill local_store append index is corrected to len-1. Native task-0 prefill/skip gate is replaced by empty matched-protocol initialization.
Parity against fixed upstream memory_update/retrieve functions covers full-buffer transitions; this is not end-to-end native-training equivalence.
identity.author_difference: This separate sensitivity uses author minority_allocation=.1, selected-victim full updates, cached-priority retrieval and first-slot full replacement; paper-literal results remain unchanged.

effective_config.derpp_allocation_adaptation: Classwise reservoir at 200/class replaces official global reservoir; objective and two independent memory minibatches retained; shared class-balanced CE and Adam/MLP protocol
effective_config.derpp_coefficient_source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aimagelab/mammoth/e75a491c69fd729edeb01431afb753d9157d9a81/models/config/derpp.yaml (seq-cifar100, buffer500); transferred fixed coefficients, not NIDS-tuned

identity.implementation_scope: Fixed-author memory control-flow port with declared underfill-index correction and matched-protocol initialization/growth, adapted to multiclass training; not native binary entry execution.

adaptations: no native task-0 skip or prefill
isolated Python Random and legacy NumPy RandomState
memory_semantics.retrieval: inverse local count with upstream global-majority-at-exact-allocation weight=1; cached priorities
memory_semantics.victim: global majority above integer minority allocation; otherwise non-majority local max; upstream insertion-order ties

publication_scope: Fixed-author memory-control-flow sensitivity under matched multiclass training, with documented underfill-index correction, empty initialization and growing capacity; not native binary reproduction. This is supplemental to the primary 60-cell matrix, not a replacement for its paper-literal results.
